arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Ball Lightning{/c} splashes on contact for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage and Stuns enemies for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} second if it reaches its Maximum range.

{c_important}Super Ball Lightnings{/c} are larger, deal  {c_number}[100|%x|]{/c} more damage, have a higher Lucky Hit Chance, and its Stun duration is increased to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} seconds.
